title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Ansible automation portal Red Hat Enterprise Linux Images
description: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform 2.2 includes the Ansible Automation Portal as a bootable container image. A notable vulnerability (CVE-2026-102278) affects the brace-expansion library used in various Red Hat environments, allowing remote attackers to cause a denial of service (DoS) by supplying deeply nested brace patterns that exhaust the call stack. This vulnerability does not compromise confidentiality or integrity but can crash server-side processes. Exploitation requires applications to process untrusted pattern inputs without depth validation. No fix is currently available that meets Red Hat's criteria for ease of use and stability.
